fact: Game #2 is labeled 'Somewhere in Kentucky — Four Days Later.' The city is not specified.
In the calibrated physical copy, the Game #2 image/title occupies physical pages 118-119 and physical page 120 is blank.

After the city extraction, the survivors are airlifted to Brazil, flown to Florence, then bused to another estate in the hills of Tuscany. Later Game 4 scenes on 'the grounds', including the Tipton/Saad duel in the wooded area at the far end of the grounds, are at this Tuscan estate.
The Chile contestants climb La Montaña Serpiente, translated as Snake Mountain, on El Fin del Mundo off the coast of Chile.
